pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 76 degrees, relative humidity 75 percent, barometer 30.18 inches,
adjusted altitude 1,656 feet. 

Pruett launched hard and was skating around from half track on.  she goes to the number one spot.
Leah Pruett's incremental times: 60ft-0.839 sec., 330ft-2.112, 660ft-2.967/295.92 mph.

Salinas with a good clean pass, straight down the groove to move up the ladder three spots.

Torrence was loose right at the hit but got it to hook up to go to the number three spot.  Billy
Torrence's incremental times: 60ft-0.845 sec., 330ft-2.140, 660ft-3.017/291.19 mph.

Gordon launched hard and was on a great pass until it pushed out a spark plug around 800 feet.  She
picks up three spots on the ladder.  Maddi Gordon's incremental times: 60ft-0.851 sec., 330ft-2.154,
660ft-3.044/284.39 mph.

Schumacher launched hard and kept the candles lit to go to the number two spot. Schumacher runs his
career fastest pass here. Tony Schumacher's incremental times: 60ft-0.843 sec., 330ft-2.132,
660ft-2.996/294.95 mph. 

Pritchett was on a good looking pass until on the top end when the car gets out of the groove and
over by the wall.  He apparently used up the engine. He still gets off the bubble to the number 11
spot.  The word from the top end is there is oil on the track.

Gary Pritchett was charged with an oildown, #1 for the season.
That will cost 5 points.

Brown launched hard and kept it hooked up to go to the number two spot.  Antron Brown's incremental
times: 60ft-0.844 sec., 330ft-2.114, 660ft-2.971/293.98 mph. 

Mercier with severe tire shake right at the hit and clicked it off.

Millican is straight down the groove with a clean pass.  Clay Millican's incremental times:
60ft-0.842 sec., 330ft-2.140, 660ft-3.027/284.03 mph.
Millican had pushed out a rearend seal.

Reed with a good pass and starts to skate around on the top end, but stays with it. He moves into the
top half of the show.  Shawn Reed's incremental times: 60ft-0.860 sec., 330ft-2.155,
660ft-3.022/291.01 mph.

Tatum kept it hooked up and hitting on all eight.  He goes to the number five spot.   Tripp Tatum's
incremental times: 60ft-0.850 sec., 330ft-2.132, 660ft-2.995/294.56 mph. 

Stewart launched hard and kept the candles lit all the way down the track to go to the number three
spot.  He makes his career fastest pass.  Stewart set the track speed record.  Tony Stewart's
incremental times: 60ft-0.842 sec., 330ft-2.131, 660ft-2.990/297.02 mph.

Ashley started to lose traction early and clicked it off.

Hart kept it hooked up and hitting on all eight to go to the number one spot.   Josh Hart's
incremental times: 60ft-0.830 sec., 330ft-2.098, 660ft-2.950/298.93 mph.  Hart makes his career
quickest and fastest pass.  He sets the track speed record.

Kalitta is straight down the groove to move into the top half of the show.  Doug Kalitta's
incremental times: 60ft-0.837 sec., 330ft-2.115, 660ft-2.980/293.22 mph. 

Langdon launched hard and had the header flames shooting over the rear wing all the down the track.
He goes to the the number two spot.  Shawn Langdon's incremental times: 60ft-0.843 sec., 330ft-2.119,
660ft-2.970/298.21 mph.
